summary: The Grid functionality involves various UI controls and functionalities related to handling button visibility, custom JavaScript confirmations, and mode switching operations such as switching to edit or add mode. It includes specific methods for managing UI elements in ASP.NET applications, handling postback events, and performing validations.
purpose: The purpose of the Grid functionality is to provide utility methods to manage UI element visibility and interaction in ASP.NET pages, ensuring proper validation and user interaction based on session settings and control states.

workflows.name: Button Visibility Management
steps: Check the current screen editability status.
Hide or show buttons based on screen editability and inactive status.
Specify tooltips and CSS classes for buttons.

workflows.name: Mode Switching
steps: Switch to add or edit mode based on user actions.
Update form view header text and mode according to the selected action.
Bind data elements to UI controls for the current mode.

business_rules: Buttons are not visible on non-editable screens unless exceptions are handled.
Certain fields like TextBox are set read-only when not editable.
JavaScript validation is conditional on session settings like UsePhoneMask.
validations: Phone and fax validation using JavaScript functions.
Governing organization selection must not be the default option.
Portfolio selection is required if cost centres are used.
conditions: Check if the screen is editable before showing edit buttons.
Determine if a row is inactive to customize button visibility.
system_behavior: System dynamically adjusts UI elements based on session and screen settings.
Elements like DropDownLists and CheckBoxes are enabled or disabled contextually.
exceptions: Buttons are hidden on error states or when conditions are not met.
JavaScript functions handle exceptions regarding field validation and visibility.
